verdict.rationale: Notte explicitly offers web agents that take natural-language tasks and carry them out on websites ("Give AI agents natural language tasks to complete on websites", "Describe a task. Watch it happen. One prompt", an agent-start API). The docs include a multi-step example: log into LinkedIn with credentials, then extract messages. One community user reported a complete failure on hyatt.com, but a single anecdotal failure doesn't concretely contradict the capability, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of form-filling and click-through flow handling, and independent hands-on corroboration of reliable end-to-end task completion.
